name: Royal Dollar
oneLiner: RUSD is RIB / Royal Coins' centralized dollar stablecoin backed by issuer-managed cash and short-term liquid reserve assets with KYC-gated mint and redemption.
collateral: Issuer-managed fiat reserve assets and short-term liquid instruments disclosed by Royal/R Coins materials
pegMechanism: Centralized 1:1 dollar token with issuer-managed mint and redemption processes for approved users

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: RUSD deploys the same non-upgradeable Circle-style FiatToken (RoyalDollar) on Ethereum, BNB Chain, and Tron, with no cross-chain functions of any kind in the contract — no LayerZero OFT/CCIP/Wormhole/Axelar hooks, only mint/burn governed by MASTERMINTER/MINTER roles (independently confirmed by reading the verified Ethereum and BSC contracts). The identical Eth/BSC address is a deterministic vanity deploy, not an omnichain token standard. Each chain's supply is minted independently by the issuer's per-chain mint authority (Eth/BSC MASTERMINTER 0xc50ebe57; Tron 0x9a0c5f3a), so there is no durable cross-chain token bridge; the "R-Bridge / RxBridge" is a hybrid Bank–OTC–Exchange business settlement network, not an on-chain supply route.

genius.notes: RUSD has issuer-style stablecoin disclosures, but no public GENIUS approval or foreign-issuer exception source was found. RIB Group Holdings Ltd / RIB Digital operates from Hong Kong/UK; no OCC, FDIC, Federal Reserve, or state regulatory filing identified. The foreign-issuer exception framework itself remains in proposed-rules phase as of 2026-06-18 with no registered exceptions granted to any issuer.

mintAuthority.summary: RUSD is issued by RIB / Royal Coins (Hong Kong) through non-upgradeable token contracts. The previously recorded owner accounts no longer hold MASTERMINTER_ROLE at the observed blocks; current DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE accounts are identified and can re-authorize minting, but no current MASTERMINTER_ROLE holder was identified.

controls.label: RUSD Ethereum DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE account
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25530829, owner() returned 0xc50ebe57ae937a8ac0bcaab8945777c3be54a511, while hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0x92067bd4) returned true and hasRole(MASTERMINTER_ROLE, 0x92067bd4) returned false. The verified source gates grantRole and revokeRole through DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and gates mintByMaster through MASTERMINTER_ROLE. Ethereum RoleGranted/RoleRevoked history shows the prior owner role assignments were revoked; no current MASTERMINTER_ROLE holder was identified in the indexed history. The deployment has no proxy, implementation, or admin slots.

controls.label: RUSD BSC DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE account
controls.evidence: At BSC block 109938049, owner() returned 0xc50ebe57ae937a8ac0bcaab8945777c3be54a511, while hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0x92067bd4) returned true and hasRole(MASTERMINTER_ROLE, 0x92067bd4) returned false. The verified token source uses DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to manage MASTERMINTER_ROLE and MASTERMINTER_ROLE to authorize mintByMaster. The deployment has no proxy, implementation, or admin slots; the former owner account is not a current mint-role holder at the observed block.

controls.label: RUSD Tron DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE account
controls.evidence: At Tron block 83931805, owner() returned the former owner 0x9a0c5f3a73fafb8bd7e7c4c8295cdd8daa87f692, while hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0xed82999e) returned true and hasRole(MASTERMINTER_ROLE, 0xed82999e) returned false. Tronscan transaction history shows 0x9a0c5f3a was granted DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and MASTERMINTER_ROLE earlier, used mintByMaster, and later renounced both roles; the current admin can re-authorize MASTERMINTER_ROLE. The verified deployment is not a proxy.

review.evidence: Current role reads resolve the control graph across Ethereum, BSC, and Tron: each deployment is immutable; a chain-local DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE EOA can grant or revoke MASTERMINTER_ROLE and can therefore re-enable direct minting, while the formerly recorded owner accounts no longer hold MASTERMINTER_ROLE at the observed blocks. No current MASTERMINTER_ROLE holder was identified, so the record does not assign direct mint authority to an unverified account.
